items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Little Trump was playing him. Yeah. He's played on my brother.

ctx.x: Wesley Dimes was killed in Baton Rouge. You didn't know that years ago?
Yeah, I didn't know he was dead. Little Trump was playing him. Yeah. He's played on my brother.
Yeah, I saw his grave up there. Yeah, well you were- He was up there?
